record.paper_title: Some Open Questions on Anti-de Sitter Geometry
record.context_brief: Equivariant spacelike surfaces in complex AdS space
record.original_question: Let S be a closed surface and let ρ_l,ρ_r : π_1(S) → PSL_2(C) be quasi-Fuchsian representations. Does there exist a ρ_l-ρ_r-equivariant spacelike embedding of the universal cover S~ into the complex anti-de Sitter space X_C = O(4,C)/O(3,C)? If such an embedding exists, can one choose one of constant curvature?

evidence.quote: Question 10.1. Given two quasi-Fuchsian representations of π1(S) into PSL2(C), is there an equivariant space-like embedding Se → XC? In this case, may we find such an embedding of constant curvature?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S$ be a closed oriented surface of genus at least $2$, and let $\widetilde{S}$ denote its universal cover. Consider the complex anti-de Sitter space
$$X_{\mathbb{C}} = O(4,\mathbb{C})/O(3,\mathbb{C}),$$
which carries a holomorphic pseudo-Riemannian metric of constant curvature; the natural action of $O(4,\mathbb{C})$ contains the diagonal action of $\mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{C}) \times \mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{C})$ via the identification $\mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{C}) \times \mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{C}) \cong \mathrm{PSO}(4,\mathbb{C})$. A smooth map $f : \widetilde{S} \to X_{\mathbb{C}}$ is called spacelike if at every point its differential is injective and the pullback of the ambient metric is a (real) Riemannian metric on $\widetilde{S}$.

Given two quasi-Fuchsian representations
$$\rho_l, \rho_r : \pi_1(S) \to \mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{C}),$$
let $\rho = (\rho_l, \rho_r) : \pi_1(S) \to \mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{C}) \times \mathrm{PSL}_2(\mathbb{C})$ act on $X_{\mathbb{C}}$ via the inclusion above.

(a) Does there always exist a $\rho$-equivariant spacelike embedding $\widetilde{S} \hookrightarrow X_{\mathbb{C}}$?

(b) If so, can such an embedding be chosen to have constant intrinsic curvature?
artifact.status_search_result: Searches surface related work on equivariant maps into (real) anti-de Sitter space and minimal Lagrangian / maximal surface results for pairs of Fuchsian or quasi-Fuchsian representations into PSL_2(R), as well as rigidity results in AdS^{2,1}. No source was found establishing existence (or non-existence) of ρ_l-ρ_r-equivariant spacelike embeddings into the complex anti-de Sitter space O(4,C)/O(3,C) for general pairs of PSL_2(C) quasi-Fuchsian representations, nor the constant-curvature refinement. Status appears unresolved based on available literature.

status_evidence.title: Equivariant maps into Anti-de Sitter space and the symplectic geometry of H^2 x H^2
status_evidence.snippet: Studies ρ-equivariant embeddings of S into AdS for ρ=(ρ_l,ρ_r) into PSL_2(R)×PSL_2(R), relating maximal embeddings to minimal Lagrangians.
status_evidence.claim: Related results exist for the real PSL_2(R) case, but not addressing the complex AdS case in full.

status_evidence.title: Deformations of Fuchsian AdS representations are quasi-Fuchsian
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses quasi-Fuchsian representations and equivariant spacelike embeddings in higher-dimensional AdS settings.
status_evidence.claim: Treats real AdS analogues; does not resolve the complex AdS question for two PSL_2(C) quasi-Fuchsian representations.
